item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 01 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Marinduque(Mogpog, SantaCruz, Torrijos), #CamarinesNorte(Vinzons, SanVicente, Talisay, Daet, SanLorenzoRuiz), #CamarinesSur(Lupi, Sipocot, Libmanan, Pasacao, SanFernando, Minalabac, Bula, Balatan, Bato, Caramoan), #Albay(Libon, Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga, LegazpiCity, Jovellar, Manito), #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, Castilla, Magallanes, Juban, Casiguran, CityOfSorsogon, PrietoDiaz, Gubat), #NorthernSamar(LopeDeVega, SanIsidro, SilvinoLobos, LasNavas), #Masbate(Balud, Baleno), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, SanFernando, Ferrol, Odiongan, SanAndres), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Mansalay, Roxas), #Catanduanes(SanAndres, Virac and Bato) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Ragay, DelGallego), #CamarinesNorte(Labo, SantaElena, Capalonga, JosePanganiban, Paracale), #Albay(Oas, CityOfLigao, PioDuran), #Masbate(Mandaon, Milagros and Aroroy) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
